title: zgwl/chinese-buy-us-stock-guide
claim: A meticulous Chinese-language guide to investing in US stocks from the mainland — brokerage and bank account opening, CRS/FATCA tax, compliance paths, funding in and cashing out.
why_good: 6.2k★ in two months for a pure docs repo is a raw demand signal: mainland investors want US exposure and face a maze of rules that no product walks them through end to end.
value: Not the repo but the service it implies: brokerage account-opening affiliates (real bounties per funded account), ITIN and tax-filing assistance, and a paid policy-change alert subscription — the free guide is the distribution.
risk: Sits on a regulatory fault line — Chinese capital controls and cross-border brokerage rules can shift overnight; it's one author's side project (1 commit/30d), and content alone is not a company.
